03 · Agent handoff

Foundation brief

Build a semantic foundation system for a case-management product. - Define separate roles for interface sans, editorial serif, and technical mono. - Test typography on titles, questions, money, metadata, tables, and long-form reflection. - Define semantic color tokens for canvas, paper, sunken plane, text, muted text, border, accent, focus, success, warning, blocked, and information. - Test every palette on real controls, tables, routes, alerts, charts, and disabled states. - Support light, dark, grayscale, projector washout, and high-contrast conditions. - Expose density and typography as bounded system choices, not arbitrary per-component styling.
